limitations: Pins the observed token bytes, not the unrecorded original download revision or tokenizer build.
Pre/post size and mtime agreement is checked; this is not an atomic immutable-volume snapshot.
No per-job remote rehash; repeat this fingerprint after the study and compare both file digests.
method: local control-plane modal.Volume.read_file streaming SHA-256; no Modal Functions

recipe_evidence.scope: Current preparation source describes the intended recipe; this does not prove the historical preparation invocation.
recipe_evidence.split: Preserve Parquet row order; zero-based document indices divisible by 100 are validation; all others training.
recipe_evidence.tokenizer: tiktoken.get_encoding('gpt2'), encode_ordinary_batch; append EOT 50256 to every document.
recipe_evidence.unknown_reason: Preparation used an unpinned dataset revision and unpinned packages; the volume contains no preparation metadata sidecar.

sampling_recipe.training: numpy.default_rng(run seed); contiguous 513-token windows with replacement produce 512 next-token targets.
sampling_recipe.validation_scope: Both samples draw from val.bin; different window draws, not separate document partitions.

storage.byte_order_evidence: Preparation and reader use native numpy.uint16 on the Linux Modal runtime; no file header.
